notes.zh: 对齐 llama.cpp 0.8.0（b11960）。Jetson 为 armv8.2-a + sm_87 自托管构建；Linux x64 CUDA 覆盖 T4/A100/A10/RTX 30xx/40xx（CUDA 12.4，仅需驱动）。linux/aarch64 暂留 b11609：官方 arm64 包已升至 glibc 2.38 基座。
notes.en: Aligned with llama.cpp 0.8.0 (b11960). Jetson: self-hosted armv8.2-a + sm_87 build. Linux x64 CUDA covers T4/A100/A10/RTX 30xx/40xx (CUDA 12.4, driver-only hosts). linux/aarch64 holds at b11609: official arm64 builds moved to a glibc 2.38 base.
